name: Livonians

colors.symbolism: the forests seen from a boat

description: Three horizontal stripes of green, white and blue in proportions 2:1:2.
history: The Livonian flag was adopted on 18 November 1923. Its colours read as the Livonian Coast fisherman's view from the sea: green forest, white beach, blue water — a deliberate parallel to the Latvian flag's structure. The Livonians are the nearly-extinct Finnic people of Latvia's Courland coast.
